400.error: That upload has no body in it.

403.error: This device is paired for chat only. Pair it again with full control from Settings → Silicon Buddy on the Mac.

411.error: This server needs a Content-Length. Chunked bodies are not read.

413.error: That request body is larger than this device may send (25165824 bytes).

415.error: That upload is not an image or a short video this Mac will keep. Send a PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, MP4, MOV or WebM.

429.error: This Mac is already keeping as many uploads from this sender as it will hold at once (200 files or 1024 MiB). Start the render from an uploadID or mediaID you already have, or send this again once older uploads expire — each is kept for seven days.

500.error: This Mac could not save that upload. Check the Mac has free space, then try again.

summary: Send a picture or a short clip, and get back the two ids that let a render start from it. Raw bytes or multipart; at most 24 MiB; kept for seven days.
